sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at City Hall, and I'm going to Central Market.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got my ticket, but there are two tram platforms.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Excuse me, does line four go to Central Market?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, it does, but you need the right direction.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: The board says Park End and River Station.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Which one stops at Central Market?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You want the tram toward Park End.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Is Park End the name of my stop?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, that's the stop at the end of the line.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Central Market is two stops from here.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I point to the tram waiting right next to us.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Does this tram go to Central Market?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Have a look at the display above this platform.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Oh, this one says River Station.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, that tram goes the other way.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So where do I go for the one toward Park End?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The Park End tram leaves from the platform across the street by the clock.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, which side of the street did you say?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Across the street, by the clock.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I cross here, or should I use the lights?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Use the lights just past the ticket machine.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll cross there and look for the clock.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Will the tram itself say Park End on the front?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, just check for line four and Park End.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: And I get off at Central Market, right?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, you'll hear the name before your stop.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I cross at the lights and find the clock.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I wait there until a tram with Park End pulls up.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I see line four on the front and get on.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Library's the first stop, so Central Market's next.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That's my stop, so I'll get ready by the door.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The doors open at Central Market, and I step out.
